title: ESP-BACK : Erector Spinae Plane Block for acute low back pain
official: Erector Spinae Plane Block for acute low back pain: a prospective double-blind randomized multicenter study. ESP-BACK
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the effectiveness of the erector spinae plane block (ESPB) in managing patients with non-specific low back (NSLB) pain, by reducing pain and allowing immediate mobility.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult (≥ 18 years)
2. Non-specific low back pain (≤ 5 days)
3. Pain score (VAS) ≥ 5 (during mobilization)
4. Inability to walk easily (failure of the "Get Up and Go" test in less than 20 seconds)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Low back pain of known specific origin: spine surgery, spine trauma, discal hernia, facet joint, radicular (sciatica, cruralgia, meralgia paresthetica), muscle pain, cancer-related or rheumatological disease
2. Subject unable to read or/and write (inability to complete a self-administered questionnaire)
3. Unavailability for follow up during 6 months
4. Referred or chronic pain
5. Participation in another clinical trial involving an investigational medicinal product or medical device within 4 weeks preceding the screening date
6. Pregnancy in progress or planned during the study period or breastfeeding women (Art. L1121-5 of the French Public Health Code)
7. Patients protected by law (Art. L1121-6 and L1121-8 of the French Public Health Code): Individuals deprived of their liberty by judicial or administrative decision, minors, adults under law protection or unable to express their consent or patient under guardianship or curatorship
8. Patients not covered by a French social security scheme or not benefiting from such a scheme
9. Absence of signed informed consent form before inclusion from the patient
10. Patient already included in the study
11. Patients with opioids (acute or chronic pain and/or misuse)
12. Acute inflammatory diseases (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis…)
13. Contraindication to regional anaesthesia
14. Contraindication to ropivacaine, dexamethasone, sodium chloride, NSAID, paracetamol, tramadol
15. Known hypersensitivity to ropivacaine, dexamethasone, other amide-type local anesthetics, or any of the excipients
16. Addiction to drugs, alcohol or medication
17. Patients with anticoagulants for a curative use (not preventive)
18. Patients with cancer or risk of bone metastasis or; severe osteoporosis
19. Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) without a negative of highly sensitive pregnancy test before inclusion or not using a highly effective method of contraception
20. Patient with severe hypotension or uncontrolled hypertension or; Heart Block (uncorrected second- or third-degree heart block without a pacemaker) or; severe bradycardia
21. Patients with severe liver or renal disease or peptic ulcer disease
22. Presence of infection or sepsis at the injection site
23. Patients with uncontrolled bacterial, viral, or protozoan infections or; systemic fungal infections or; active untreated tuberculosis or; active ocular herpes simplex infections
24. Patients with uncontrolled diabetes mellitus
25. Patients with glaucoma or history of severe glaucoma
26. Patients with severe psychiatric conditions
